$comment: Tells the root commands (npm run setup / dev / demo / verify) which app to run.
"app": null means template mode: no app yet. `npm run create-app` (or the product-interview skill) sets it.
When set, "app" is an object with these fields (paths are relative to this file, with forward slashes):
name        - the app's display name, e.g. "My App" (required)
backendDir  - the FastAPI folder with requirements.lock; its .venv is created here (required)
docsDir     - where product.md, architecture.md, acceptance.md and plan.md live, e.g. "app/docs"
backendApp  - the uvicorn import path, default "app.main:app"
healthPath  - backend URL that answers when it is up, default "/api/health"
ports       - {"backend": 8000, "frontend": 3000}; BACKEND_PORT / FRONTEND_PORT (environment or root .env) override them
devEnv      - extra environment variables for `npm run dev`, e.g. {"DATA_MODE": "live"}
demoEnv     - extra environment variables for `npm run demo` and the verify browser test, e.g. {"DATA_MODE": "fixtures"}
smokeSpec   - Playwright test filter run by `npm run verify`, default "e2e"
APP_PYTHON (environment or root .env) picks the Python used to create the backend .venv. Never put secrets in this file.
